title: Most Common Word
description:
Given a string of text (lowercase, space-separated words), return the word that appears most frequently. If there is a tie, return the word that comes first alphabetically.

**Example:**
```
most_common_word('the cat sat on the mat the') → 'the'
most_common_word('a b c a b') → 'a'
most_common_word('dog cat bird') → 'bird'
```

tests.name: Clear winner
input: the cat sat on the mat the

hint: Build a frequency dict. Find max frequency. Among all words with max frequency, return the alphabetically smallest.
